subject: biology
title: Energy Inside Cells
welcome_lead: Travel into mitochondria to see how every cell releases energy from food.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on respiration, its equation and why cells need it.
final_note: You now understand respiration — how living things release the energy they need.

concepts.def: Releasing energy from glucose in cells.

Power released for growth and movement.

walkthroughs.body_html: Respiration: glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water (+ energy). It happens in every living cell, all the time.
Respiration takes place mainly in mitochondria. Cells that need lots of energy, like muscle cells, contain many mitochondria.
Energy from respiration is used for movement, growth, repair, keeping warm and brain activity. Without respiration, cells would die.
